text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: Adopt the Beverage Cans site’s bright pink as a single accent color for interactive elements. It stands out against the Keychron K4’s dark grey, making buttons and links pop without clashing. The trade-off is reduced subtlety—bright pink risks feeling playful rather than sleek—but it aligns with AI’s need for approachable, modern energy.

name: Squint
text: Bright pink as an accent risks making the AI site feel like a toy, not a tool—users expect seriousness from AI products. A muted coral or deep magenta would pop without undermining professionalism; test both against Keychron’s dark grey to see which balances visibility and credibility. The call is settled by A/B user testing on a live prototype.

name: Easel
text:
I’ll apply the muted coral accent to the AI site’s interactive elements and export a style guide showing it against the Keychron K4’s dark grey. This produces a visual reference the lead can approve or reject in one glance.
